(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    chicken bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates (raw ?i - item) (grilled ?i - item) (stackable ?i - item) (stacked ?i - item) (ready ?i - item) (grill_free))

    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) (at end (stacked bun_bot))))
  (:durative-action stack_chicken
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable chicken)) (at start (grilled chicken)) (at start (stacked bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable chicken))) (at end (stacked chicken))))
  (:durative-action stack_bun_top
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)

(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    chicken13 patty13 potato13 fish13 yam13 lettuce13 cucumber13 stock13 bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (marinator_free)
  )
  (:functions
    (cutting_board_available)
    (boiler_available)
  )
  (:durative-action grill
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and
      (at start (raw ?i))
      (at start (grill_free))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (not (grill_free)))
      (at end (grilled ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (grill_free))
    )
  )
  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and
      (at start (raw ?i))
      (at start (>= (cutting_board_available) 1))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (decrease (cutting_board_available) 1))
      (at end (cut ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (increase (cutting_board_available) 1))
    )
  )
  (:durative-action fry
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and
      (at start (raw ?i))
      (at start (fryer_free))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (not (fryer_free)))
      (at end (fried ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (fryer_free))
    )
  )
  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and
      (at start (raw ?i))
      (at start (>= (boiler_available) 1))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (decrease (boiler_available) 1))
      (at end (boiled ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (increase (boiler_available) 1))
    )
  )
  (:durative-action marinate
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and
      (at start (cut ?i))
      (at start (marinator_free))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (cut ?i)))
      (at start (not (marinator_free)))
      (at end (marinated ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (marinator_free))
    )
  )
  (:durative-action mash
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and
      (at start (boiled ?i))
      (at start (>= (cutting_board_available) 1))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (boiled ?i)))
      (at start (decrease (cutting_board_available) 1))
      (at end (mashed ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (increase (cutting_board_available) 1))
    )
  )
  (:durative-action grill_chicken13
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and

      (at start (grill_free))
    )
    :effect (and

      (at start (not (grill_free)))
      (at end (grilled chicken13))
      (at end (stackable chicken13))
      (at end (grill_free))
    )
  )
  (:durative-action fry_potato13

    )
    :effect (and

      (at start (not (fryer_free)))
      (at end (fried potato13))
      (at end (stackable potato13))
      (at end (fryer_free))
    )
  )
  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot

    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and

(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    tofu04 potato04 zucchini04 carrot04 celery04 peas04 bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates (raw ?i - item) (cut ?i - item) (marinated ?i - item) (grilled ?i - item) (boiled ?i - item) (mashed ?i - item) (fried ?i - item) (stackable ?i - item) (stacked ?i - item) (ready ?i - item) (grill_free) (cutting_board_free) (fryer_free) (boiler_free) (marinator_free) (done_grill_tofu04) (done_mash_potato04) (done_boil_peas04) (lag_ready_stack_tofu04) (lag_from_mash_potato04) (lag_from_boil_peas04))
  ; Generic actions
  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?i - item) :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i))) (at start (not (cutting_board_free))) (at end (cut ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (cutting_board_free))))
  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?i - item) :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i))) (at start (not (boiler_free))) (at end (boiled ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (boiler_free))))
  (:durative-action marinate
    :parameters (?i - item) :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut ?i)) (at start (marinator_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (cut ?i))) (at start (not (marinator_free))) (at end (marinated ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (marinator_free))))
  (:durative-action mash
    :parameters (?i - item) :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (boiled ?i))) (at start (not (cutting_board_free))) (at end (mashed ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (cutting_board_free))))
  ; Item-specific actions for non-raw inputs
  (:durative-action grill_tofu04
    :parameters () :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (marinated tofu04)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (marinated tofu04))) (at start (not (grill_free))) (at end (grilled tofu04)) (at end (stackable tofu04)) (at end (grill_free)) (at end (done_grill_tofu04))))
  (:durative-action fry_zucchini04
    :parameters () :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut zucchini04)) (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (cut zucchini04))) (at start (not (fryer_free))) (at end (fried zucchini04)) (at end (stackable zucchini04)) (at end (fryer_free))))
  ; Stack actions
  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot
    :parameters () :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) (at end (stacked bun_bot))))
  (:durative-action stack_tofu04
    :parameters () :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable tofu04)) (at start (stacked bun_bot)) (at start (lag_ready_stack_tofu04)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable tofu04))) (at end (stacked tofu04))))
  (:durative-action stack_carrot04
    :parameters () :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable carrot04)) (at start (stacked tofu04)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable carrot04))) (at end (stacked carrot04))))
  (:durative-action stack_celery04

    :condition (and (at start (stackable celery04)) (at start (stacked carrot04)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable celery04))) (at end (stacked celery04))))
  (:durative-action stack_bun_top

    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_top)) (at start (stacked celery04)) (at start (lag_from_mash_potato04)) (at start (lag_from_boil_peas04)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_top))) (at end (stacked bun_top))))
  ; Wait actions for temporal constraints
  (:durative-action wait_grill_tofu04
    :parameters () :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (at start (done_grill_tofu04))
    :effect (at end (lag_ready_stack_tofu04)))
  (:durative-action wait_mash_potato04

    :effect (at end (lag_from_mash_potato04)))

stage_records.domain_pddl:
(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing :numeric-fluents)
  (:types item robot)
  (:constants
    sausage11 mushroom11 shrimp11 okra11 cassava11 pickle11 beans11 - item
    robot1 robot2 - robot
  )

  (:predicates (raw ?i - item) (cut ?i - item) (marinated ?i - item)
               (grilled ?i - item) (fried ?i - item) (boiled ?i - item)
               (mashed ?i - item) (robot_free ?r - robot)
               (grill_free) (fryer_free) (boiler_free) (marinator_free))
  (:functions (cutting-board-available))
  (:durative-action grill
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i))
                    (at start (robot_free ?r))
                    (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i)))
                 (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
                 (at start (not (grill_free)))
                 (at end (grilled ?i))
                 (at end (robot_free ?r))
                 (at end (grill_free))))
  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i))
                    (at start (robot_free ?r))
                    (at start (>= (cutting-board-available) 1)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i)))
                 (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
                 (at start (decrease (cutting-board-available) 1))
                 (at end (cut ?i))
                 (at end (robot_free ?r))
                 (at end (increase (cutting-board-available) 1))))
  (:durative-action fry
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i))
                    (at start (robot_free ?r))
                    (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i)))
                 (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
                 (at start (not (fryer_free)))
                 (at end (fried ?i))
                 (at end (robot_free ?r))
                 (at end (fryer_free))))
  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i))
                    (at start (robot_free ?r))
                    (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i)))
                 (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
                 (at start (not (boiler_free)))
                 (at end (boiled ?i))
                 (at end (robot_free ?r))
                 (at end (boiler_free))))
  (:durative-action marinate
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut ?i))
                    (at start (robot_free ?r))
                    (at start (marinator_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (cut ?i)))
                 (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
                 (at start (not (marinator_free)))
                 (at end (marinated ?i))
                 (at end (robot_free ?r))
                 (at end (marinator_free))))
  (:durative-action mash
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled ?i))
                    (at start (robot_free ?r))
                    (at start (>= (cutting-board-available) 1)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (boiled ?i)))
                 (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
                 (at start (decrease (cutting-board-available) 1))
                 (at end (mashed ?i))
                 (at end (robot_free ?r))
                 (at end (increase (cutting-board-available) 1))))
  (:durative-action grill_mushroom11
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (marinated mushroom11))
                    (at start (robot_free ?r))
                    (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (marinated mushroom11)))
                 (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
                 (at start (not (grill_free)))
                 (at end (grilled mushroom11))
                 (at end (robot_free ?r))
                 (at end (grill_free))))
  (:durative-action fry_okra11
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut okra11))
                    (at start (robot_free ?r))
                    (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (cut okra11)))
                 (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
                 (at start (not (fryer_free)))
                 (at end (fried okra11))
                 (at end (robot_free ?r))
                 (at end (fryer_free))))
)
